# orca requirement

Every `orca requirement` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca requirement show <group>`

a requirement's rounds, drafts and document

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca requirement open --idea <idea> [--group <group>] [--language <language>] [--limit <limit>]`

open a requirement from an idea; the group id is generated unless --group names one

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-open`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--idea <idea>` (required): what to build
- `--group <group>`: the new group's id
- `--language <language>`: en|zh: the requirement's content language
- `--limit <limit>`: the requirement's budget as JSON {tokens,activeMs,attempts,sessions} — human-only: needs a person token

```
orca requirement open --idea "add a dark mode"
```

## `orca requirement answer <group> [--answer <answer>] [--glossary <glossary>] [--adr <adr>]`

answer the current round: --answer <qid> takes the recommendation, --answer <qid>=<text> answers in words

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-answer`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--answer <answer>` (repeatable): <questionId> or <questionId>=<text>
- `--glossary <glossary>` (repeatable): <id>=accept|reject
- `--adr <adr>` (repeatable): <id>=accept|reject

## `orca requirement consensus <group>`

close clarification at the current round

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-consensus`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca requirement continue <group>`

grant exactly one more clarification round after the cap

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-clarify-more`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca requirement revise <group> --round <round> --file <file>`

revise an answered clarification round (a new round; at most one clarify call)

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-revise`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--round <round>` (required): the round number to revise
- `--file <file>` (required): the answers JSON {answers, glossaryDecisions, adrDecisions, reason?, exclude?}

## `orca requirement feedback <group> --text <text>`

ask for a new draft of the split

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-draft-feedback`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--text <text>` (required): what to change

## `orca requirement accept <group>`

accept the current draft: the group becomes a draft task group

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-draft-accept`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix

## `orca requirement classify <group> --scope <scope> --clarity <clarity>`

set the requirement's class (it sets the clarification caps)

- What it does: sends control verb `requirement-classify`.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<group>`: a group id or a unique prefix
- `--scope <scope>` (required): small|medium|large
- `--clarity <clarity>` (required): the clarity class
